newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Eurotunnel debt off on agreement news - traders.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Eurotunnel debt off on agreement news - traders.

text.p: LONDON, October 2 (LPC) - Distressed debt traders say that Eurotunnel bank debt offer levels are off slightly, to 35 percent of face value from 37 percent, on news that the company has reached an agreement on basic principles with the steering group of its creditor banks.
"At best it's neutral, at worst it's negative," said one trader.
Eurotunnel bank debt last changed hands at 37 percent, but trading has been thin, in part because of banks' reluctance to make provisions against a loss.
"Trading should pick up steam in a couple of weeks and we may see a flurry of deals," a trader said.
"This is positive in that no one really thought they'd come up with a plan by now and they have," a trader said.
